Highlights:
# Crucial P3 Plus 4 TB (Micron N48R FortisFlash)

 4 TB 

Capacity

 Phison E21T 

Controller

 QLC 

Flash

 PCIe 4.0 x4 

Interface

 M.2 2280 

Form Factor

 

Controller

The Crucial P3 Plus is a solid-state drive in the M.2 2280 form factor, launched on May 25th, 2022. It is available in capacities ranging from 500 GB to 4 TB. This page reports specifications for the 4 TB variant. With the rest of the system, the Crucial P3 Plus interfaces using a PCI-Express 4.0 x4 connection. The SSD controller is the PS5021-E21T from Phison, a DRAM cache is not available. Crucial has installed 176-layer QLC NAND flash on the P3 Plus, the flash chips are made by Micron. To improve write speeds, a pseudo-SLC cache is used, so bursts of incoming writes are handled more quickly. The cache is sized at 1100 GB. Thanks to support for the fast PCI-Express 4.0 interface, performance is excellent. The P3 Plus is rated for sequential read speeds of up to 4,800 MB/s and 4,100 MB/s write. At its launch, the SSD was priced at 400 USD. The warranty length is set to five years, which is an excellent warranty period. Crucial guarantees an endurance rating of 800 TBW, a relatively low value compared to other SSDs.
